label: HVAC and Commercial Refrigeration Service
equipment_families: walk-in or reach-in cooler or freezer
required_views: wide equipment and safe access context
customer issue controller or alarm before work
coils filters fans fittings ducts and drains as applicable
measurements with instrument units mode and location
matched before and after repair views
controls alarms and complete operating cycle
store refrigeration equipment pair box case doors defrost drain and temperature as applicable
restored panels guards service caps cleanup and final safe state
unsafe_signs: live exposed electrical parts or uncontrolled hazardous energy
unsafe ladder landing rooftop edge or access path
intentional refrigerant release or unqualified refrigerant-circuit work
active fuel leak unsafe combustion damaged heat exchanger blocked or disconnected vent or carbon monoxide hazard
missing electrical panel access cover fan guard service cap or equipment panel after work
high-pressure industrial ammonia carbon dioxide transcritical boiler chiller cooling tower or complex VRF condition without qualified manager review
active commercial refrigeration alarm iced coil blocked drain failed door or gasket or unverified temperature closeout
score_criteria: Equipment and job mode are identified only from visible evidence
Only applicable views are required and non-applicable items are explained
Matched before and after angles clearly show components fittings ducts drains cases or boxes
Measurements include instrument units mode location conditions and named target source
No visible high-severity safety issue is ignored
Controls and complete operating cycle are documented
Panels guards service caps filters and work area are restored
Complex commercial and food-safety decisions are routed to a qualified manager
manager_gates: active refrigeration alarm or product-temperature concern

bid_hint.note: HVAC/R pricing is disabled until the company connects its own rate book. Return 0/0 and state that a qualified manager must scope and confirm pricing.
